'''Metalic_Jaguar Can't lose...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Metalic_Jaguar]]
* '''Published:''' 27 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 HB Metalic_Jaguar LS 2003 Cantlose.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a very powerfull space/droid deck. Review for me please and give me advice.
